scope: Read-only review of existing simulated recordings for a physical judging procedure; not a hardware trial or a new simulation assessment.

demo.measurement_domain: native simulation; no ruler measurements inferred from video
measurement_notes: Pocket depth/width fields are binary threshold encodings from the archived geometric containment test, not continuous measured insertion depths.

A video frame at step/20 depicts its recorded control interval; native interval completion is (step+1)/20.

measurement_notes: Seating diagnostic is native simulator data, not a replacement valid-physics benchmark assessment. The original contact-invalid zero is preserved.

visual_review.source: Existing exported RGB montages sampled and viewed; not reconstructed or re-rendered simulation.
visible_findings: Demo views show a lifted covered head with the right hand at the handle.
Model final views show the cover and frame still separate.
not_established_by_rgb_alone: 40 mm insertion across the entire central 80 mm with verified upper/lower pocket layers.
A hardware before/after inspection of both cloth faces and every sewn boundary.
Calibrated centimetre-scale displacement, angle and whole-arm clearance bounds throughout motion.
visual_review.physical_worksheet_status: Cannot be certified as a real trial from these existing images; native simulation evidence is reported separately.
